version_list.title: myXL
version_list.label: myXL
version_list.description:
The latest version of myXL is an application that makes it easier for you to carry out various activities such as an internet packet activation, balance checking, and the remaining quota checking. Also, you can manage several XL Prepaid, XL Postpaid, and XL HOME accounts at once in just 1 myXL application.

New features in myXL:
1. Check Remaining Quota and Balance
2. Package Activation
3. Top Up Balance
4. Share Balance
5. SIM Card Activation
6. Buy Gadgets
7. FAQ page
8. Live Chat Service
9. Manage up to 10 of your myXL Accounts
10. PUK code
11. Activate Roaming and Buy Roaming Packages
12. Activate Family Plan to manage shared quota on myXL
13. Activate packages & billing payment using balance, Gopay, OVO, Credit Card, and Bank Virtual Account
14. Adjust your spend limit for Postpaid user
15. XL Center Info
version_list.description_short: myXL is a self-service telecom app that manages XL Prepaid, PRIORITAS, and XL HOME in one place.

* Optimization on My Package page
* New look of XL Satu to XL HOME

* Others bug fixes and UI refinement
